visual_policy: Actual cells, tissues and biological compartments dominate; sparse labels, no protocol/checklist template.

Space follows the RQ’s biological focus. Use compact controls when they serve only as references; equal panels are appropriate only when both processes or comparisons are equally central. Matching and inferential importance do not mandate equal canvas area. Preserve meaningful tissue, time, model and perturbation comparisons.
Use local labels and line styles to separate published premises, proposals, predictions and measured observations.
Unknown molecular features, products, directions, assays and biological units stay unknown.
All icon counts, sizes and geometry are qualitative; do not draw fake numerical plots.
Keep full hypotheses and primary/repository source citations in the owning context; no new biological claim or literature search.
Inspect actual output at native and approximately 800-pixel width; a prompt is not evidence of output fidelity.

Earlier native-SVG fallback restriction was superseded by explicit owner authorization on 2 November 2026. No registered placeholders. Preserve existing figures, hashes, hypotheses and gallery architecture.
Generated BioRender output requires separate editable-access, export-format and intended-reuse qualification before integration; do not weaken the inert-SVG gate.

questions.question: A3

Separate proposed “programme unknown” and “independent function unknown” readouts. Use a labelled dashed reference comparison; chronology does not imply survival of identical individual cells. A small rival strip preserves normal ageing, ongoing input, mixture and processing. Step 2: a repairing alveolus, labelled "Resolution".

From the step-3 macrophage, two SEPARATE dashed purple arrows lead to two SEPARATE outcome boxes on the right, each with a large question mark:
box 1 "Persistent programme? (not yet specified)"
box 2 "Independent function? (not yet specified)"

COMPACT REFERENCE INSET (small, top right corner, about one sixth of the canvas): a normal alveolus with an alveolar macrophage, labelled "Reference: no prior injury". A dashed bracket connects the inset to the step-3 macrophage, labelled "Population comparison: matched age, origin, state and resolved present context".

BOTTOM STRIP (small text): "Alternatives: normal ageing, cell mixture, ongoing tissue input, sample processing".

Footer (small): "Proposed comparison; not an observed effect. Not the same individual cells."

Draw only cells and tissue; no molecular pathways, metabolites, graphs or data.

changes.question: A3
changes.rationale: The scientific focus is injury/resolution and its post-resolution macrophage consequence; no prior injury is a reference. Equal areas distracted from the biology and were explicitly rejected by the owner. Matching does not require equal panel area.

changes.question: A6
changes.rationale: IPF within-state RNA and abundance are the biological focus; the control context provides the reference. Compact control frees space for both distinct readouts without claiming a disease mechanism.

changes.question: A7
changes.rationale: The two baseline states are both central to the interaction and remain prominent. Only the repeated control within each genotype contrast becomes compact; state comparison and broad-loss versus interaction interpretation are preserved.

unchanged_groups.rationale: Both source/target contexts are central to correspondence or fixed-component replication; neither is merely a display control.
Early-to-later linkage is central; preserve both temporal endpoints.
Existing anatomy/compartment/readout focus does not impose equal control panels; A31 already specifies a compact matched comparison and A32 supplies the reference grammar.
Parallel lineage tracks distinguish acquisition from selection; they are not interchangeable control panels.
Repair versus lesion context is meaningful to the beyond-shared comparison; retain its visibility.
Epithelial versus fibroblast recipient questions remain genuinely open; do not visually select one.
Schedule contrasts are central and need aligned timing; current wording does not require equal scene areas.
Competing explanatory models are central, not reference-only controls; do not diminish rivals mechanically.
Fzd2 versus Fzd1 are two active receptor contrasts, not focal treatment versus an incidental control.
Paired tissues/compartments jointly define the estimand; keep both visible.
Total and fixed-composition views are complementary descriptive comparisons, not reference-only arms.
